segments.segment_summary: A man in a baseball cap and sunglasses stands in a dry field, talking to the camera about the effects of the drought in Kansas and the challenges of farming.

key_moments.caption: A man begins to speak to the camera about the effects of drought in Kansas.
He talks about how people see farming as fun but it has challenges.
The man states they have been facing challenges for the last 12 months.

segments.segment_summary: The camera pans across a dry, brown, and patchy lawn in front of a house, illustrating the impact of the drought on what is normally a green yard.

key_moments.caption: A close-up shot shows a very dry, patchy lawn.
The camera pans to reveal a white house with a red roof and a silo in the background.
The camera pans back over the brown, dead-looking grass.
A wide shot shows the dry lawn with several large green trees lining the gravel driveway.

segments.segment_summary: The video shows a pasture where a pond has significantly receded, leaving a small pool of water surrounded by cracked mud. Cattle are gathered around the remaining water source.

key_moments.caption: A shot of a pasture pond with a very low water level, with cattle standing in and around the water.
The camera pans across the dried, cracked mud that was once the pond bed.
A wide view shows the herd of cattle grazing in the dry pasture near the diminished pond.
The camera pans across the dry, sparse pasture land.
